upstream.build_driver: package/local-completion/calculix-9zt-probe/build_probe.py --patch package/calculix/force-accounting/hooks.patch --extra-source package/calculix/force-accounting/forceaccounting.c --contact-source package/calculix/force-accounting/contactstate.c --runtime-prefix <stable dependency prefix>; also supply --source-archive, --recipe and new --workdir

interface.capacity_query: ccx --freecad-force-accounting-capacity exits zero with one JSON CCX_FORCE_ACCOUNTING_CAPACITY_V1 document: request_schema CCX_FORCE_ACCOUNTING_V3, allocation dynamic, counting_policy top-level-declarations-v1, total_records B and limits supports/bodies/ports/angles/springs each B. This reports a declaration resource policy, not available memory or physical-model validity. Invalid configuration exits nonzero; it never silently falls back to a smaller graph.
interface.capacity_configuration: V3 uses one shared total budget B, default 65536. CCX_FORCE_ACCOUNTING_MAX_DECLARATIONS optionally sets B per process using canonical decimal [1-9][0-9]* in 1..2147483647. Empty values, signs, whitespace, leading zeroes and overflow reject. Count every SUPPORT or SPC_SUPPORT, BODY, PORT, ANGLE and SPRING once; their child IDs/terms do not consume additional declaration records. The sum of all five categories must not exceed B. Checked allocations, native integer dimensions and actual memory availability may impose stricter limits; raising B does not guarantee a solve.
interface.capacity_run_receipt: The actual V3 preparation emits exactly one CCX_FORCE_ACCOUNTING_CAPACITY_APPLIED_V1 stdout line containing budget, all five counts and total. Fresh dynamic-capacity FreeCAD runs freeze the exported effective budget in the child environment and require that owned successful child's exact matching receipt before importing Current data. Saved JSON alone does not establish process custody.
interface.compatibility: The V3 executable retains literal V1 and V2 requests, matching-version output and their original supported domains and refusals. V1 retains its MPC-body refusal and does not acquire an MPC row. V2 does not acquire ordinary-SPC support selection or scalar spring composition. FreeCAD generates V3 requests and requires a V3 executable for fresh runs; old requests must be regenerated by the normal writer. Literal V1/V2 reports remain readable without inventing new channels, support roles or V3 provenance.
interface.output: <request path>.out; matching version header, final STATE, named SUPPORT/CUT/LOAD/CONTACT/MPC six-component rows, END. V2 and V3 require an MPC row for every requested body, including a literal zero resultant when no MPC acts. V3 SPC_SUPPORT requests produce named SUPPORT wrenches, not a new ordinary RF channel.
interface.state: Final converged output state of one static step; importer requires the exact requested end time
interface.support_request: SUPPORT <name> <reference node> <rotation node>; exact declared native RBE identities, all six prescribed at zero
interface.spc_support_request: V3 only: SPC_SUPPORT <name> <term count>, followed by exactly that many <node> <direction> pairs. The count is positive and cannot exceed the native boundary count. Each direction is 1, 2 or 3 and must identify exactly one original finite zero native SPC without amplitude. Selected terms must be structural solid-mesh translations outside every requested cut body, never reference/rotation ports or angular/helper nodes. Names share the SUPPORT namespace; selected node/direction pairs cannot overlap.
interface.port_request: V3 only: PORT <name> <reference node> <rotation node> for each declared RBE port. Identities are detached from all structural volumes and do not overlap. The original native RIGID equations must bind the declared reference/rotation nodes and represent all translational/rotational directions. FreeCAD independently requires an explicit non-collinear solid-mesh receiving region. The native represented-mode check is not a new geometric area/rank proof. A moving internal PORT is not an external SUPPORT.
interface.angle_request: V3 only: ANGLE <auxiliary node> <rotation node> <axis X> <axis Y> <axis Z>. The finite unit axis is proved against the actual original homogeneous native equation before decascade: auxiliary DOF1 equals the declared axis dotted with the declared rotation-node components. At output the auxiliary angle remains a native dependent DOF and its unused DOFs2/3 are zero SPCs. Auxiliary coordinates do not locate a force or couple and auxiliaries are never external supports.
interface.spring_request: V3 only: SPRING <element> <endpoint node 1> <endpoint node 2>. Every active native SPRING2 (ESPRNG21) must be declared exactly once with exact native connectivity. Endpoints have no incidence in any structural volume, including unrequested bodies, and are either two distinct RBE reference nodes or two angular auxiliaries bound to distinct RBE rotation nodes with the same axis. All PORT/ANGLE/SPRING declarations must be used. The actual native spring-force path checks a finite positive, single-table linear law and matching translational directions1..3; angular springs act only on untransformed auxiliary DOF1/1.
interface.body_request: BODY <name> <element count> <cut-node count>, followed by explicit element IDs and complete shared-interface node IDs
interface.ownership: Cut-body selection is explicit. Native topology checks reject undeclared shared-node interfaces, body SPCs, MPC participation on a cut/shared node, and ambiguous cut-node concentrated loads. Every MPC force attributed to a body acts at a node whose incident structural volumes all belong to that body. A contact side must have one exterior parent volume, including matching midside identities.
interface.support_semantics: Native internal nodal force minus actual consistent external element/nodal loads, projected together in topological order through the actual acyclic native MPC graph. Fully decascaded coefficients are the diagonal special case. An RBE rotation-port residual is a reference-point couple; native code translates the reference force to the global origin. V3 ordinary SPC support wrenches sum only the explicitly selected, actually zero-prescribed residual components and their original-position cross products. No free-direction reaction is inferred. Output accounts for the selected physical supports, not an assertion that every external restraint has been selected.
interface.cut_semantics: Equilibrium-derived force and global-origin moment acting ON the declared AccountingBody across its only shared-node interface: -(LOAD + CONTACT + MPC). No recovered-stress integration and no reconstructed body loads.
interface.mpc_semantics: Net native MPC action on AccountingBody, not a per-Tie multiplier or row-attributed force. From unprojected native internal nodal force fn (including contact internal terms) minus actual physical nodal external loads p, solve C_D^T lambda=(fn-p)_D on the unique dependent DOFs of the actual native constraint matrix C. Topological elimination admits an acyclic remaining dependency graph; a fully decascaded graph is the diagonal special case. Accumulate q=C^T lambda on all terms and sum q and x_original cross q on body-exclusive nodes. The remaining projected residual supplies support reactions. Do not subtract CONTACT from fn-p, reuse combined RF, or relocate row forces. Aggregate q is invariant under equivalent row scaling, ordering and decascade substitutions; individual row labels/multipliers are not.
interface.connector_semantics: V3 uses the actual native scalar-spring internal nodal force already assembled into fn. The actual RBE/angle MPC graph transfers its contribution to body-exclusive structural nodes and the projected external-support residual. Do not add spring forces a second time to LOAD, CONTACT or MPC. A rotational auxiliary carries a generalized angle and conjugate couple, never a force at its dummy coordinates. Scalar SPRING2 does not by itself qualify arbitrary offset application points or a joint's physical constitutive model; independent force/original-origin-moment and scalar response checks are required for the actual fixture.
interface.contact_semantics: Native face-to-face spring nodal force contributions, negated from the internal-force assembly sign and attributed separately to actual master and slave parent volumes. Each side's moment uses its own original nodal application positions. No slave-moment sign flip is used as a master-moment substitute.
interface.load_semantics: Actual native consistent element RHS before active-DOF filtering; concentrated loads included once when body ownership is unambiguous
interface.frame: Global Cartesian, original reference-state nodal positions; FreeCAD writer units N and Nmm. V2/V3 keep an immutable coordinate snapshot and reject any actual native coordinate change after preparation, including contact adjustment. V3 separately captures original MPC equations before the first main decascade, without changing them; output projection still uses the validated actual output-state graph. A nonzero Contact.Adjust setting is not itself rejected if no coordinates actually change. V1 retains its legacy behavior and does not qualify adjusted original-coordinate frames.
interface.ordinary_channels: RF, SOF/SOM and CF remain unchanged. SOF/SOM is still recovered/extrapolated/averaged stress integration; CF moments still use deformed slave positions. The new output is separately named and is not numerically interchangeable with those channels.

supported_domain.solver: Standalone 32-bit-integer CalculiX 2.23 plus pinned build-8 fixes and this extension
supported_domain.analysis: One small-displacement mechanical implicit static step, original global coordinates
supported_domain.mesh: C3D4/C3D10 solids with current native CAD entity ownership metadata for FreeCAD cut selection; V3 additionally admits only the explicitly declared native scalar SPRING2 constructions below
supported_domain.contact: Optional triangular face-to-face penalty contact, frictionless, frictional or finite-penalty tied; both master/slave ownership directions. An ordinary MPC Tie alone does not require a dummy penalty Contact.
supported_domain.supports: Disjoint native RBE regions with all six motions prescribed at zero. V3 also admits explicitly selected ordinary Fixed or partially constrained Displacement boundaries whose selected structural translational DOFs are prescribed at zero without amplitude and lie outside all cut bodies. Partial/free/moving RBE ports are not external SUPPORT records.
supported_domain.internal_ports_and_connectors: V3 moving internal native RBE ports on explicit non-collinear solid-mesh receiving regions, composed with native two-port translational or rotational scalar connectors. Reference/rotation IDs are not structural element nodes; angular auxiliary nodes are detached generalized coordinates with actual native equations. Only finite positive single-table linear SPRING2 laws with matching directions are admitted. The original RBE/angle graph and actual output graph must satisfy their separate identity and acyclicity checks. Internal transfer remains aggregate MPC action, not external reaction or a per-connector/per-Tie force report.
supported_domain.cut_bodies: Explicit solid unions, no body SPC, complete single declared shared-node cut interface; MPC participants must be body-exclusive and off that interface
supported_domain.mpc: Homogeneous translational constraints with finite coefficients, unique nonzero non-SPC dependent pivots and an acyclic remaining dependency graph at the actual output state. Exact-zero coefficients create no graph edge. Ordinary native Tie uses ADJUST=NO, original coordinates and no cyclic symmetry. Supports may participate in native RBE dependency chains retained by the contact solver; the output is aggregate MPC action, not per-law attribution.
supported_domain.limits: V3: dynamically allocated declarations and multiword body ownership, subject to the shared configurable total budget documented above and checked native allocation/dimension bounds. Qualified complete analytical graph: 1 ordinary support, 264 bodies, 264 moving ports, 792 angular auxiliaries and 792 scalar springs, total 2113. This is not a universal size or performance guarantee. Literal V1/V2 retain their original independent 64-support/64-body limits and ignore the V3 budget setting. No multi-step reuse or in-process CalculiXstep reuse.
not_supported: adjusted ordinary Tie or changed native reference coordinates
partial/free/moving RBE ports requested as external SUPPORT
nonzero or amplitude-bearing ordinary support constraints
SPRING1/SPRINGA/dashpots, grounded scalar connectors, direct structural-node spring endpoints, mixed translational/angular spring endpoints, nonlinear or multi-table scalar spring laws
ambiguous or missing body ownership or physical constraint attribution
nonzero self/cyclic MPC dependencies, repeated dependent DOFs, invalid links or nonfinite coefficients/residuals

FreeCAD_use.solver: Enable NativeForceAccounting on CalculiXCcxTools. Empty NativeAccountingSolver selects the separately bundled qualified executable, not the user's ordinary ccx preference.
FreeCAD_use.support_selection: The saved solver NativeAccountingSupports LinkList selects physical external support constraint objects from the same analysis. An empty list retains the earlier all-fixed-RBE selection behavior for existing documents; it does not silently include ordinary Fixed/Displacement supports. A nonempty list explicitly selects supported zero Fixed/Displacement constraints and/or fully fixed RBE constraints. Moving internal RBE ports are omitted from external supports without being grounded or removed from the physical model. The normal writer resolves exact stock node/DOF identities and rejects overlapping/redundant physical constraint attribution, including ambiguity with unselected constraints; native input may already have collapsed duplicate boundary declarations.
FreeCAD_use.capacity_preflight: Before stock mesh-set creation/export, enumerate the complete active, suppression-aware analysis graph and report required versus supported support/body/port/angle/spring counts and total. Every active RBE remains a PORT regardless of selected supports or cuts. Admission is only a resource check; normal ownership, geometry, constraint and native-domain checks still apply. Export binds the complete effective policy, graph and selected binary; a fresh prelaunch query rejects changed capacity/binary/graph before output quarantine. Old capacity-less V3 exports remain subject to both original 64/64/64/384/384 limits and the current selected policy. No graph truncation, grouping, grounding or solve splitting is performed.
FreeCAD_use.port_resolution_lifetime: One writer operation shares lazy public mesh-coordinate, volume-incidence and verified receiving-region snapshots across its rigid-port and connector writes, then clears the context on success or failure. Accounting-request preparation uses its own fresh operation-local context. Public standalone calls remain fresh; no document/global/cross-export cache survives reference edits, remesh or analysis Group reorder. Public dictionaries and native auxiliary IDs retain their semantics. This does not eliminate every CAD/mesh validation cost.
FreeCAD_use.cut: Enable NativeEquilibriumCut on a Section Force object and select AccountingBody solid(s) owning the selected one-sided facets. The reported wrench acts on that explicit body; do not fit signs to targets.
FreeCAD_use.result: Separate Native force accounting (N, Nmm) object with readable resultants and JSON provenance: deck/request/binary/output hashes, model fingerprint, frame, separate LOAD/CONTACT/MPC terms and applicability
FreeCAD_use.staleness: Model changes, including physical support selection or connector changes, invalidate current accounting; cold restoration is explicitly historical until rerun. Failed/partial, nonfinite, wrong-time, wrong-identity and inconsistent outputs are not imported as current. Literal restored V1/V2 data is not repaired or promoted to V3; only a normal fresh writer/solver run establishes new current accounting.
FreeCAD_use.material_fingerprint: FreeCAD-4jb fingerprints native Materials.Material contents rather than temporary wrapper addresses in both accounting and mesh diagnostics. Identity/model declarations, qualified exact typed values and quantity units are retained. FreeCAD-3sc uses the additive native Array2D.TypedArray interface to retain nulls and actual Quantity/float/integer/boolean/string cells without legacy Quantity coercion. Genuine native cell edits remain provenance changes. Old requests must be regenerated by the normal writer after fingerprint changes; saved reports remain historical. Ambiguous physical/appearance property names, unsupported native value types, nonfinite populated values and runtimes lacking the qualified typed interface reject explicitly; no material hash bypass is provided.
FreeCAD_use.deployment: Optional CMake FREECAD_NATIVE_CCX_ACCOUNTING points to the qualified executable. App data/NativeSolvers carries the separate binary and source/contract/license. Standard ccx and global preferences are not replaced.

contact_state.FreeCAD_request_and_inspection: Save selected active ordinary Contacts in SolverCcxTools.NativeContactOutputs; an empty list disables only these diagnostics. Both synchronous ccxtools and the native solver task-panel honor this selection, including contact-only runs with NativeForceAccounting false and dual-opt-in runs preserving V3/movement sources and owner-specific ContactObservation. Both runners scrub inherited activation requests. Inspect the separately named native local contact output result by double-click or its context menu; missing constitutive values remain unavailable. Closing/cancelling an owned GUI run withdraws it and reaps its child before closing.
contact_state.FreeCAD_source_domain: Physical dependencies must belong to the same document, recursively through analysis/mesh links and nested resolved App::Links, excluding outputs. External dependencies refuse rather than aliasing identical local object names. NativeAccountingSolver must be a saved absolute path for contact diagnostics; an empty selection uses the separately bundled data/NativeSolvers/ccx-force-accounting. Bare/relative PATH/cwd lookups refuse. Export/run/import bind the actual capability-qualified executable's resolved path and hash; current reads re-resolve the saved selection, including symlinks. The ordinary ccx preference remains unchanged. Bound-file and executable-selection topology events withdraw an open inspector without automatically refreshing it.
contact_state.FreeCAD_run_and_persistence: Each owned child has a unique immutable request/token/output path. A per-analysis latest-attempt fence ignores superseded completions without invalidating a newer result. Every rewrite/new attempt withdraws previous availability; restoring old files cannot resurrect a withdrawn completed run. Cold restore retains literal frames, raw labels and provenance as Historical. Explicit refresh only succeeds when all exact physical and file identities still match. Native Gmsh save/load can drop point cells and renumber source elements: such history cannot be promoted onto the new labels and requires a fresh normal stock export/owned solve/import. No label remapping, native sample recovery or saved-fingerprint migration is performed.
contact_state.purpose: Separately activated diagnostic observations of actual native contact samples and constitutive branches; not contact-law, equilibrium or design acceptance
contact_state.source: contactstate.c is included from forceaccounting.c and must be copied alongside that source by the pinned build overlay. The existing V1/V2/V3 accounting format and mechanics are unchanged.
contact_state.activation: CCX_CONTACT_STATE_REQUEST=<request path>, independent of CCX_FORCE_ACCOUNTING_REQUEST; contact-only operation does not require or activate force accounting
contact_state.request: Whitespace grammar: CCX_CONTACT_STATE_V1, REQUEST <32 lowercase hexadecimal characters>, END_TIME <finite positive number>, UNITS MM N MPA, one or more PAIR <result contact name> <native slave surface name> <native master surface name>, END, then EOF. Identifiers are 1..80 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen/dot without whitespace. Surface names omit the internal native T marker and are compared case-insensitively. Each request must bind exactly one native declaration per pair, with no repeated result contact names or native pair identities.
contact_state.output: <request path>.out is one JSON object, atomically replaced from <request path>.out.tmp after each retained native output frame. Top-level schema, echoed request, complete, units, position_frame, basis_frame, sample_identity_scope=FRAME_LOCAL_NATIVE_CATALOGUE, face_inventory, sample_inventory and frames are explicit. The request identity is a custody token, not a cryptographic digest; FreeCAD separately binds exact export/run request, deck, executable, successful owned child and output hashes.
contact_state.domain: Standalone 32-bit-integer CalculiX 2.23; one small-displacement global-coordinate mechanical implicit-static step; original C3D4/C3D10 tetrahedra; ordinary face-to-face penalty contact with exponential, linear or tabular normal law and optional finite positive Coulomb friction/stick slope. Tied penalty, node-to-face, mortar, massless, thermal/dynamic/cyclic/transformed/NLGEOM, changed reference coordinates and changing selected sample label/count inventories between retained frames are refused. The selected normal law and actual scalar outputs are observed, not changed.
contact_state.frames: Only actual iout=2 retained native result evaluations are captured, after native worker joins. Each frame has step, increment, cumulative time, success, complete and samples. Top-level and final-frame complete require exact requested end time; successful owned process completion remains separately required. Earlier retained frames are preserved. Exact repeated output of the same last step/increment/time replaces that frame; otherwise increment must strictly increase and cumulative time must not decrease. Distinct increment IDs may legitimately share time for the native final zero-size contact correction increment.
contact_state.coverage: The complete selected native slave-face/integration-point catalogue is enumerated from itiefac, islavsurf and pslavsurf before contact-law callbacks. Independent face_inventory records contact/native_pair/slave_element/slave_face/expected_points, including native zero-point faces. Independent sample_inventory records contact/native_pair/slave_element/slave_face/native_point/local_point. Every frame has exactly that label/count inventory. Native generation/refinement changing those labels or counts between retained frames rejects; unchanged labels/counts do not assert unchanged quadrature locations or material-point continuity. Each frame retains its actual native slave_parameters, paired master_parameters, weight, positions and basis. A native zero-point face is not repaired by inventing a sample.
contact_state.sample_identity: sample_identity_scope=FRAME_LOCAL_NATIVE_CATALOGUE. native_point is the actual frame-scoped igauss index and local_point its actual offset in that slave face's native catalogue, not a persistent material-point identifier across increments. native_pair is the native tie index. Slave and preserved master element/face identities are copied from native structures, not matched by coordinates. slave_parameters and paired master_parameters are that frame's actual native xi/eta, with master_parameters null when unpaired. Pair selection is proven against actual native slave/master surface declarations, so multiple pairs do not depend on local DAT labels or FRD recovery.
contact_state.active: ACTIVE rows copy the native spring's current slave/master positions, normal, clearance, pressure and representative area. Frictional tangent vectors, total tangential CDIS and shear are copied from the actual law evaluation. STICK and SLIP callbacks are inside the corresponding native branches, not inferred from nonzero displacement or Coulomb ratios. ELASTIC_OVERRIDE identifies the native elastic-calculation override. FRICTIONLESS rows keep tangential constitutive quantities unavailable because the native friction branch was not evaluated.
contact_state.plastic_slip: plastic_slip_increment is the actual native dg in the current increment's sliding return, or literal zero when the native sticking branch retains plastic history unchanged. plastic_slip_vector is dg times the actual native global sliding direction, in global coordinates. These are increment quantities, not accumulated travel or lifetime slip. tangential_displacement is total history-dependent CDIS including elastic sticking and plastic history; it is not renamed plastic slip.
contact_state.inactive: INACTIVE means that this catalogued, preserved-paired sample has no generated contact spring at this output. It is not inferred open from absence. A read-only observer uses native stored slave/master parametric positions, native shape3tri/shape6tri with iflag=1, current co+v, slave clearini*reltime, native preserved normal and initial-penetration reduction to evaluate the same preserved projection at output. It never generates, searches, reprojects or evaluates a constitutive law. evaluation=NATIVE_PRESERVED_PROJECTION and engagement=OPEN_AT_PRESERVED_PROJECTION only when this explicit clearance is positive. State stays UNAVAILABLE and pressure/shear/plastic increment stay null. UNPAIRED rows retain the slave point but master identity, geometry/basis, clearance, area and constitutive quantities are null. Neither category is silently zero-filled or promoted to a measured law response.
contact_state.frames_and_units: Declared writer units are mm, N and MPa (N/mm2). CalculiX cannot independently infer units from numbers; FreeCAD must bind this declaration to its stock writer. Positions are current positions including native clearance adjustments, not original reference positions. basis_frame=NATIVE_MASTER_NORMAL; frictional active tangents are copied from the actual law, while inactive/frictionless tangents use the identical native master-normal convention solely for diagnostics. Tangential scalars are local components, not global XYZ.
contact_state.strictness: All populated numeric quantities must be finite; unavailable quantities are JSON null. Dimension/identity, reference-coordinate, duplicate sample, missing generated-sample evaluation, output write and native catalogue inconsistencies fail explicitly. No output is imported Current after a failed, partial, stale, wrong-request or wrong-time run. The native observer supplies diagnostic evidence only and does not relax any engineering tolerance or authorize an original-project solve.

beam_section_interface.build: Add --beam-source package/calculix/force-accounting/beamsection.c --beam-patch package/calculix/force-accounting/beamsection.patch to the pinned build_driver invocation. The additive beam patch is applied after the unchanged hooks.patch; the receipt binds both extra sources and both patches.
beam_section_interface.activation: CCX_BEAM_SECTION_REQUEST=<fresh owned request>, per child process only. FreeCAD BeamSectionForces defaults False; opt-in requires Output3d=False and the qualified bundled executable.
beam_section_interface.request: CCX_BEAM_SECTION_V1; REQUEST <32 lowercase hexadecimal nonce>; END_TIME <finite positive time>; UNITS MM N NMM; ELEMENT <element> <first node> <middle node> <last node> for every active original B32R; END. One record per line, original CalculiX connectivity ordering, complete catalogue, no duplicate IDs.
beam_section_interface.output: <child request>.out is strict JSON, atomically published from a fresh exclusive temporary file. Complete frames have native step, increment, actual FRD STRESS dataset identity, time and exactly two distinct end samples per requested element. Successful owned child completion is required separately before Current publication.
beam_section_interface.sample_identity: ELEMENT_END_BEFORE_NODE_AVERAGING: original element, original node and end 1 or 3. Multiple incident ends at a shared original node remain separate. Section, material, dimensions, reference orientation and selected analysis/solver/mesh case are bound to the unchanged stock writer's deck in provenance.
beam_section_interface.observer: Diagnostic-only capture of already calculated native per-face quadrature traction and centroid-relative moment increments during map3dto1d2d, before original beam-node averaging. Legacy numerical expressions, arrays, mechanics and ordinary outputs are unchanged. Earlier expanded-node stress extrapolation/averaging remains native; this is not an equilibrium recovery or universal accuracy repair.
beam_section_interface.frame: Positions and e1/e2/normal are the actual native section-map centroid and face basis from co plus the map's vold argument. In the linear-static path that argument can still describe preceding/reference geometry; ordinary FRD U uses current solved v. Do not interpret section-map positions as solved displacement or add FRD U while retaining the old centroid-relative moment. Published V1 CURRENT_EXPANDED_SECTION/NATIVE_CURRENT_FACE_BASIS strings remain legacy wire markers; newly built observers additionally identify geometry_source=CO_PLUS_NATIVE_MAP_VOLD_ARGUMENT. V2/V3 name the frames NATIVE_MAP_EXPANDED_SECTION/NATIVE_MAP_FACE_BASIS explicitly. force_global and moment_global are global outward native element-end actions, moment about the native map centroid. Both orthonormal handednesses are valid, including a left-handed first-end basis.
beam_section_interface.channels: Native local channels project the observed global force and moment: shear1=F.e1, shear2=F.e2, axial=F.normal, torque=M.normal, bend2=M.e2, bend1=M.e1. Units are N for forces, N*mm for moments, mm for positions. CalculiX does not independently infer units from numbers; the stock FreeCAD writer binds these declarations.
beam_section_interface.stress_separation: SECTION FORCES reuses the legacy FRD S slots for forces and moments. FreeCAD never imports those channels as MPa, von Mises or principal stress. A known section-output marker overrides later flag changes; Off/rewrite preserves the old FRD recoverably before retiring markers. A bare original-beam FRD with stress slots is ambiguous and refused without a trusted ordinary solver-input context.
beam_section_interface.supported_domain: V1 retains straight quadratic B32R rectangular pure-1D, unsplit small-displacement linear static 3D output. Output3d, trusses, full integration, nonlinear materials/geometry, split decks and other sections remain refused. V1 mixed meshes remain refused; the separate V2/V3 bounded additions below do not waive those legacy boundaries. NativeForceAccounting and NativeContactOutputs are separate incompatible opt-ins in these beam domains. These are qualification boundaries, not universal CalculiX limitations.
beam_section_interface.persistence: Saved literal frames, axes, section/case metadata and hashes survive save/cold restore as Historical output. Cold restore never fabricates Current process ownership. Current getters bind the physical model, original mesh, absolute selected executable, unchanged deck/base request, unique child nonce/output and exact fresh FRD; changed inputs, cancellation, failure or missing sources withdraw access. The inspector labels historical data explicitly.
beam_section_interface.qualification: Small stock-authored analytical fixtures use predeclared signed free-body references and unchanged 1% force/moment vector limits. Wire consistency is separate. Exact source/native hashes and serial run receipts are retained with FreeCAD-960 evidence. This is software/output-method qualification only and grants no Oomakhi or building design acceptance.

beam_ground_coupling_interface.capability: --freecad-beam-coupling-version prints CCX_BEAM_SECTION_V2; the V1 capability and literal requests remain supported
beam_ground_coupling_interface.domain: One connected monotonic straight uniform rectangular B32R chain along a global axis, one stock ElasticConnector Vertices/Translational/Ground SPRING1 at a simple zero-offset endpoint, one zero five-DOF Displacement guide at that endpoint leaving the spring direction free, and one opposite-end native vertex force. One material, static step and complete declaration catalogue. No other constraints, user equations, knots, transforms, amplitudes, distributed loads, RBE, solids, contact or accounting opt-ins.
beam_ground_coupling_interface.request: V1 header/units/ELEMENT records plus SPRING owner element original_node direction; SOURCE owner original_free_tip_node; SUPPORT owner original_guide_node count original_directions; END. Unique nonce and the same owned deck/binary/model/FRD custody rules apply.
beam_ground_coupling_interface.actions: Per native retained frame, native_actions carries actual source point-load action, actual SPRING1 fnl (native resisting sign) and its negative ground-on-model action, and the native projected SPC reactions observed inside the unchanged resultsforc path before native add-back. Source/spring/support positions are original global coordinates; moments are about the original global origin. Mechanical native arrays are never modified by the observer.
beam_ground_coupling_interface.support_roles: Original beam translations are forces. Native MEANROTBS DOF1 is an angle with a physical conjugate couple along the captured native axis; its DOF2 is an algebraic inhomogeneous term excluded from physical wrenches even when nonzero. Every active mechanical SPC must have an exact declared role. Actual external loads on dependent or prescribed DOFs refuse rather than silently substituting a combined RF value.
beam_ground_coupling_interface.qualification: Independent translated 10-N series and small-displacement transverse controls, scalar law, six-component beam-end actions, original-origin moments, nonzero angle/algebraic terms, stale withdrawal, visible inspection and cold history. Per-fixture limits are recorded in freecad-sv7-oracles.md; there is no universal displacement or force-accuracy promise. Existing FreeCAD-960 tests remain required.

beam_solid_coupling_interface.capability: --freecad-beam-solid-version prints CCX_BEAM_SECTION_V3; published V1 behavior and the V2 grounded domain remain separate
beam_solid_coupling_interface.authoring: Saved ElasticConnector Attachment=Vertex to rigid body port, Kind=Translational, Mode=Two points, End1 an original beam endpoint, RigidBody2 one active explicit Tet-only RBE, End2/RigidBody1 empty. Old enumeration choices migrate by preserving their selected label and references. Native spring endpoints are the original beam node and detached RBE reference, never its rotation or receiving nodes. The native scalar axis and the two endpoint positions must be collinear. This is one scalar translational interface, not a six-component joint law.
beam_solid_coupling_interface.domain: One uniform straight rectangular B32R chain, one connected genuine C3D4 solid owner, one explicit non-collinear Tet receiving region with all six RBE port modes free, one native SPRING2, one opposite beam vertex force, one zero five-DOF beam guide and one disjoint Fixed solid support. Original beam and solid nodes are disjoint; reference/rotation/algebraic nodes are detached. Stock native writeABAQUS mode 2 exports both physical dimensions without promoting volume boundary faces to shells.
